title: coloc.susie.direct: colocalization of SuSiE fine-mapping credible sets in FinnGen
description: WDL pipeline for pairwise colocalization of SuSiE credible sets produced by the FinnGen fine-mapping pipeline. It tests each overlapping region pair with coloc and reports posterior probabilities of a shared causal variant, together with the credible set variants supporting each colocalization.
